# Contributing to QxGram

QxGram is an independent Telegram Desktop fork. Report QxGram issues and
propose changes in this repository, rather than the upstream issue tracker.

Before submitting a change:

1. Describe the problem and the intended behavior.
2. Keep changes focused and include relevant tests.
3. Follow the [Windows build guide](../docs/building-win.md) when applicable.
4. Preserve existing copyright notices and license information.
5. Never include account data, access tokens, private keys, or other secrets.

QxGram is distributed under the GNU GPLv3. See [LICENSE](../LICENSE) and
[LEGAL](../LEGAL) for details and upstream attribution.
